reviews.text: Friendly, clean, and so good with my dogs. This is a great place, it's worth the wait for an appointment.

The doctors here are actually very nice, caring, and professional, which makes this even more disappointing. Unfortunately, the front desk staff is awful. It is extremely difficult to get through to anyone, and when you do, you are often placed on hold for long periods of time.

I’ve been trying for over a week just to schedule an appointment for my dog. The lack of communication and difficulty accessing care is incredibly frustrating. The veterinarians themselves have been great, but the front desk experience seriously takes away from the quality of the practice. I would consider going elsewhere simply because scheduling and communication should not be this difficult.

Extremely frustrating experience with the front desk. I’ve been trying for over a week to schedule an appointment for my dog, and every time I call, I’m asked whether it’s an emergency and then placed on hold for an excessive amount of time. At this point, something that may not have initially been an emergency becomes more concerning when you can’t even get through to schedule your pet to be seen.

It should not be this difficult to make a basic veterinary appointment. Communication and accessibility from the front desk need serious improvement. Unfortunately, based on my experience, I would not recommend this office. There are other veterinary practices in the area, and you may have better luck getting timely assistance elsewhere.
Dr. Yard and staff are so caring and patient.
Caring, friendly, and knowledgeable.. wouldn't take my furbabies anywhere else!

Wissahickon is wonderful - we’ve taken two dogs here over the years, including one we adopted right from the vet. The staff is always kind, goes out of their way to explain things, and will answer questions over the phone if needed.
I work with a local shelter, my senior foster Minnie gave 5 stars, she was quite impressed. She gave a 13/10 rating. 🐕🐶 …
Very thoughtful and caring staff! Incredibly knowledgeable care and a well managed facility!
This place is the best they saved our cat who had an obstruction and were always available to answer any questions and help us along through his recovery. also very affordable.
Our best vet yet!  Tucker loves them!

I had to make the difficult decision to put down my beloved dog Eddie and the staff was so friendly and caring. They showed true empathy and respect while guiding me through it all. You can really tell that these people love what they do. Thank you for being so kind💛
The vets of Wissahickon and the entire staff definitely love what they do. Every pet is greeting with a smile and treated in a gentle,caring ,way.

We adopted a dog in July 2025. She was around six years old. Shortly after adopting when he found a bump on her vulva area. Turns out it was a mast Cell tumor. Our primary care vet were not suited to remove the tumor. We went to another place and the cost was astronomical. We contacted Wissahickon creek And not only were they very reasonably priced, they were amazing with my dog. From the moment, Dr. yard came into the room she sat on the floor and made sure my dog was comfortable. They explained in detail the procedure, and did such a great job. Even though I’ve only been there a couple times, I got a great sense of relief that my dog was in good hands. I would recommend them to anyone
Dr. Yard is incredibly knowledgeable, and we take all of our animals to her.
I had been taking my dog here for years and everyone there was always so kind and professional.

Losing my sweet Sophia was one of the hardest things I’ve ever gone through. Although she did pass following surgery, I cannot say enough about the compassion and humanity this veterinary team showed me during such a devastating time.

From the moment things took a turn, they treated both Sophia and me with genuine care, patience, and empathy. The veterinarian spoke with me with such kindness—it didn’t feel clinical or rushed, it felt human. You could tell they truly cared.

What meant the most to me was what they did after. They handled her cremation with dignity, created a beautiful keepsake, and even went out of their way to personally deliver her remains to my home. That level of thoughtfulness is something I will never forget.

In the worst moment of my life, they gave me comfort, respect, and peace. I am forever grateful.

My dog loved the vet and the space. He had never behaved better at a vet before here! Prices were explained and reasonable. My dog showed swift improvements too. Definitely recommend them!

I will say that it can get quite busy quickly in the lobby, so if your dog is reactive or easily excitable to ask to wait in your car until time :)

Wissahickon Creek Vet is hands down the best, most attentive and caring vet I have even been to. I bring my dogs and my cats here, and I always have an amazing experience. I love all the doctors I have worked with here, here but especially Dr. Flynn, she is always so understanding and willing to answer any of my crazy pet owner questions.

Whenever I go everyone is always very nice! Although vet costs everywhere are expensive these days they do their best to not charge you for things not necessary at the time. If you had a sick exam recently they don’t charge you at vet exam fee for vaccines unless it was something necessary.
So friendly and great with my dog! One of the best vets I’ve ever been to

Wissahickon Creek Vet saved my beloved cat Gourdie's life twice! He unfortunately has PICA and has had to have multiple bowel obstruction surgeries. The first one was done at an expensive Philly vet that charged twice the price for the same services, so I was happy to find Wissahickon Creek Vet as another option for ultrasounds and surgeries. They were helpful, quick to get an appointment, efficient, and most importantly successfully treated my cat who's now thriving with lifestyle changes and medication.
Great veterinary service, I've been bringing my pets here since the late 70's. Caring Vets, staff is always super friendly and professional. My vets are Drs Yard and Kilkucki. Highly recommend.
Baxter has never been more at ease coming to Wissahickon Creek Veterinary Hospital. He never liked to go to the vet until we brought him here 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

Dr. Yard and the entire staff at Wissahickon Creek are the best at what they do. Both my cat and dog have special needs and are patients of the practice. I have no doubt that they are being given the best care possible. This truly is a community veterinary practice and they deserve all the support and accolades for their work.

I took my both my babies to this “vet” for shots, checkups over the years, but more so I purchased my cat food from them consistently rather than order online. My baby whose about 12/13 years old (rescued as a kitten) is dying…I called them, was told by a young man to hold on while he go speak with the vet, he came back to literally tell me “to go somewhere else” pretty much…don’t have anything available for a cat whose dying, never again!

I ask about Saturday, Sunday, Monday, nothing, nothing, nothing…Maya Angelou states, “when people show you the first time who they are BELIEVE IT!”

-Vets
-Medical Doctors
-Dentist
-Corporate America

What a systemic industry…I guess my MINXIE doesn’t matter…because a caring vet would have told me to bring him in, they would have squeezed him in, especially if he’s dying, not send a receptionist back with a message “to take him somewhere else!”

Thank you Banfield…who I forgot did a wonderful job with my dog Shebah when her time came…MINXIE and Shebah were very close, at least I can take him for his last ride to the very vet that took care of my beloved dog. I hadn’t been there in years after her death, yet they told me to bring my baby and they will make sure that he’s comfortable, that I can stay as long as I want to say goodbye.

Now that is customer service regardless of who you are!

adopted a dog 3 weeks who injured her paw.  Called @ 8am and was told to come in at noon!! They accepted the shelter voucher.  Everyone from front desk to doctor were great.  In and out in an hour with a full exam and medication.  $100 for everything, which I feel is beyond reasonable.  The office is clean and efficient.  No improvement needed here.
Love it my dog medicine
Love the service...

Wissahickon Creek has been the best veterinary facility I have ever taken my pup to.   They are super accommodating with appointments and genuinely seem to do the best they possible can for our pup.  It’s also the only vet I’ve ever taken my pup back to after an appointment and her anxiety is relatively low, which is a testament to how the staff treats her.  Would highly recommend this facility to anybody in the greater Philadelphia area.
They have taken such great care of our small chihuahua and also treated us as parents with patience and respect. We will miss them as our primary care vet as we have moved to MD
They’re always great on answering questions

I've taken my dogs here all my life. I love the attention to detail and quality of care that Wissahickon provides. I have three dogs of varying ages, all of which have their own unique health concerns. Dr. Yard is great at listening and explaining what options are available, while also considering cost and making pragmatic decisions to help the wallet.
The front of house staff that runs the desk is great as well. They're always pleasant, organized, and thoughtful. All three of my dogs are on long term medication. I'm frequently coming in for refills. They're always great about getting me in and out as quick as possible.
Super friendly and knowledgeable staff.
The people that work there are nice & understanding.

We bring our three cats and our dog to this vet. We’ve been to a bunch of different vets in different states moving with the animals over the years, and this is one of the best ones we’ve had. When we rushed in in a panic because one of our cats was acting erratically, they promptly diagnosed him with a urinary blockage and had him in surgery quickly. We believe they saved his life with their quick action! We tell everyone to go here.
A bit pricey but they are nice.

My poor dog needed major surgery that my vet wouldn't do because it was complicated. Dr. Yard not only did the surgery, but did an amazing job and a very reasonable price. We are most appreciative. We live too far away or we would be regulars here. Thank you Dr. Yard!
The vet is great, not so crazy about some of the staff.

Called to make a emergency visit  and was told no doctors will be in for a full week. I responded that it was irresponsible to not have any doctors on at all at the practice and she sat and there and argued and laughed at me.

I scheduled an 11:30am appointment for my dog's Wellness check. I was told to wait in my car until a vet tech comes out to get me  - "first come, first serve" were the words I got when i called to check in. At noon I was still waiting in the parking lot,. I understand that times get busy, but why tell me I have an appointment and then make me wait outside for a "first come first serve?" I am also busy, and resent the bait and switch on appointment times. If I did this at my job I would be fired. I will not be bringing my dog here anymore. Get it together, folks!

We recently transferred our dog’s care to this vet and are thrilled! The providers are attentive and thorough. They obviously work hard to maintain accessible prices while providing exceptional care and I am so grateful!

I recently moved away from the area, and I didn't want to leave without mentioning how awesome your staff and care had been for my two pups; Marshall and Tibi. You guys really went above and beyond for them, and always made sure they were as safe and comfortable as possible. We thank you!

My cat is a formerly stray rescue who gets extremely scared to go to the vet. He is normally a nice boy but can be a difficult patient at times because of this. The vets at Wissahickon Creek take great care of him even when he's acting up which I appreciate greatly. They also are very reasonably priced compared to other vets. Would recommend!
Excellent,  friendly,  compassionate, fair priced,  kind, thorough care for my pets, and my entire family brings their respective pets from various neighborhoods to this vet. They are that great.

Doctor Yard is absolutely amazing. She is caring and passionate about her work. She talks and takes care of your pet like no other one I have seen. She was an angel to my dog during the pandemic as she was able to attend my emergency right away. I can’t say enough good things about her. Simply wonderful.

I highly recommend them. The staff from the receptionist to the DVMD were very pleasant and helpful. This was my first time here with our new addition Coco (Yorkipoo). Looking forward to future visits.

I came home to find my little fur baby had passed away. Needless to say I was very emotional. I went to the SPCA who informed me that they no longer perform cremations and there was a man there that referred me of Wissahickon Creek Veterinarian and how they went above and beyond when he was in the same situation.  I went there and they were extremely nice to me. I would recommend them to anyone.

Words are inadequate to describe the overwhelming patience, kindness, compassion and care with which pets and their people are treated here.  Dr. Yard, who is clearly a skilled clinician, takes the TIME to speak with the families to ensure they understand each and every procedure.  The entire staff is warm and welcoming and treats your pet EXACTLY as they treat their own.  I can not recommend this place highly enough.

We have been taking our dogs to WCVH for years. They have consistently provided excellent care at a reasonable cost. I have recommended this veterinarian to friends and have heard positive feedback from them as well.
Fast service, prices are reasonable. They took great care of my puppy.

My cat Salem had early stage pyometra, we were searching all over for vets that could perform the surgery for an affordable price until we finally found this place. Thank you Wissahickon vet for saving our baby :)
Wonderful staff who treated my cat respectfully and with love
My 1 1/2 year old cat needed emergency surgery and other hospitals prices were ridiculously expensive.  Wissahickon was reasonable and everyone there were fantastic.

I highly recommend Wissahickon Creek Veterinary Hospital because 2 years ago they took wonderful care of my cat Gracie. Dr Yard and her staff are warm, caring people who will treat you and your pet with the utmost respect.
Gracie had a lot of health issues, so over a period of 3 months she was there 5 times, even staying there for 2 weeks, because during her stay I was hospitalized and they kept her an extra week, and was willing to work within my limited budget.
They loved my cat, and treated her like she was a celebrity. I will always sing their praises because they are the best.

Have been taking all of my pets throughout the years to WissVet!! Super friendly service and treats your pet like their own! Nala my cat had her wellness visit yesterday and could not have gone any better! Dr. Yard and her staff are top notch!!

Peaches loved Dr Flynn, nurse Jamie and the  reception staff was the sweetest! Our visit was so smooth and personable, we highly recommend coming here for primary care. Our kitty is excited to visit as well :)

Dr. Yard has now basically saved the life of two of my dogs. About 5 years back, my dog Spunky had a detached lens (or something of that sort) in both of his eyes. Dr. Yard performed a double enucleation (i.e., double eye removal) and my husband and I were able to spend another year with Spunky right at the start of COVID quarantine when it would've REALLY hurt even more to lose him. More recently, my dog Olivia developed a very swollen, ulcerated toe. Even though I switched to a different primary vet a few years back (and had already got the initial lab testing done by an emergency hospital), Wissahickon Creek Vet's clerical staff got Olivia scheduled for a toe amputation surgery about 2 weeks out from my original call. Dr. Yard amputated the toe, and another mass on Olivia's lip, with clear margins. Both times, my dogs had a pretty uneventful, successful recovery and I credit that to Dr. Yard's skill.

Having a veterinary practice right here in Roxborough that can do this type of more complicated surgery is a godsend -- not only because it means more dogs in the area are able to receive this level of care + more quickly, but also because Wissahickon Creek Vet's prices make it easier on those who would otherwise be faced with a tough choice of incurring an exorbitantly high bill or doing nothing/euthanasia.

Are they a busy practice? Definitely.

Are their wait times longer than average? I would say yes, so plan ahead for that to the greatest extent that you can.

Do they sometimes forget to do things? For sure, but not Dr. Yard herself. In my opinion, it's due to how busy they are as well as doing a lot of things without the pet owner in the room. I switched a few years back because I felt like the car-side service during COVID lasted too long and was the reason for certain questions not being answered/smaller concerns about my pet not being addressed. Still, in my experience the oversights happen at more or less the same frequency as the other two super busy veterinary hospitals in the area that I've taken my dogs to over the years.

All-in-all: if you're looking for a vet that can address a LOT of different issues in-house, at reasonable prices, and with a head doctor that is great at what she does then this is your place.
